        "question": "团队到底交付什么，相对手工多会话有何增量？",
        "answer": "面向需要队长拆解、不同角色/模型分工并保留过程的DSH任务。已有办法是手开多会话、复制简报、手写任务/结果；本项用角色/班底/任务副本、主任务与小任务合同、attempt/token、事件和邮箱组织多会话。成员通过startContinuable真的起独立子会话，persona与模型路线可不同，不能把它说成一个模型仅换口吻，也不能把每段提示称独立Skill。\n\n新增交付物是带任务ID、验收章节、尝试与交接记录的任务单/SQLite状态，以及共享留言板、每任务纪要和计划/文档目录。它让任务有可查询的责任行和阶段记录，但实际工作质量与文件/业务验收仍由人/外部条件判定。README“你批准后执行”是高层描述；本版本approve_plan已下线，需看收口和派发实现，不能承接旧审批保证。状态存本地不等Agent任务不联网。",

        "question": "派发/链/完成与重试真正保证什么？",
        "answer": "dispatchCore在进程内team锁下读快照，异步prepare先起成员，再同步SQLite事务写attempt/状态/事件/邮件，提交后渲染和唤醒。已有pending/running会拦重复派发，claim匹配副本行后发token；requireLiveAttempt核assignee、taskMemberId、running与token，改派吊销旧token后迟到报告不能直接改当前尝试。这是有实质状态机约束的执行接线。\n\n依赖已撤硬闸，只排序提示；链是弱顺序，任意成员可追加/乱序派，frontier按成功站点推进。不能将DAG/链图宣传成前置完成或严格逐站审核保证。同成员跨主任务副本独立占用，没有全队总并发/模型请求预算。\n\ncomplete只要求非空output并存changedPaths自报，标attempt succeeded；链所有站有成功才task completed、最后小任务可收组并续派下一棒。没有执行验收标准、核输出文件存在或独立审核结果，completed是协议报告完成。后续派发/唤醒失败不回滚已完成状态，邮件保留但无持续消费者时不等必送达。failTask立即同成员重试至maxRetries后wait领队，重试不核外部副作用是否已发生，idempotencyNote只是文案，不能承诺重复执行安全。",

        "question": "SQLite与重启对账解决什么，还遗漏什么？",
        "answer": "状态/事件/邮箱同BEGIN IMMEDIATE同步事务提交，抛错ROLLBACK，避免一个任务状态写了但同库事件没写的普通半步；WAL/NORMAL/busy_timeout3000，外键OFF，引用完整性由代码维护。进程内team FIFO锁拒绝也不毒化后续，是可靠性优点。但锁不是跨进程业务锁，dispatch在锁内await spawn后用旧team入事务，多host共享库虽SQLite写串行，也不能自动防旧快照覆盖。spawn成功到事务提交之间崩溃/写失败有外部会话已建、状态未登记窗口，没有见该帧自动dispose补偿；DB事务不回滚Agent创建和文件操作。\n\n对账以agents.list活集合与DB在办attempt比较，缺会话且时长>=60s则撤销/paused，不把重启误当任务成功。只有启动立即与1/3/6/10s快扫，之后无周期；若启动时尝试年龄小于50s且没有新事件，全部快扫仍在宽限期，之后不会等到60s再扫，可能持续残留running。agents服务异常返回空集合，也可能把其实活的旧尝试误挂起。测试分别验证grace和不轮询，不覆盖二者组合的最终再判定。\n\n因此已有持久状态与恢复诊断有价值，但不能称任意崩溃自动接续或正好一次执行。恢复应核活会话/已发生文件及外部动作，不仅看task卡。",

        "question": "工作目录、产物和删除可否当隔离与原子恢复？",
        "answer": "task.workDir冻结建任务时当前会话目录，一个主任务共享teams/<id>-slug，简报给出工程/留言板/纪要/文档绝对路径，降低成员自行猜路径与跨工作区漂移；docs是派生视图，留言板create-only、纪要分宿主合同与模型正文。该布局不是每成员worktree/sandbox，所有成员和其它进程仍可能写同项目/共享文件，依宿主工具权限和人为分工。\n\n固定bundle stateDir硬编码C:/Users/epat/.eteams，优先于config默认.eteams；跨工作区共单库。作者Windows路径不是每位用户的数据根，首次必须审查/改成自己可写目录；POSIX上自定义绝对判据识别盘符，不保证node:path对盘符同Windows行为。workRoot配置存在，但docs用固定WORK_ROOT=teams，不把它当已有效任意路径设置。\n\n删除未开始主任务会级联元数据/副本并在DB事务内rmTree任务目录，失败warn仍可提交删除；反过来rmTree已成功后后续DB错误回滚不会复原文件。rmTree用Dirent.isDirectory，普通符号链接本体unlink不递归，这一点不应夸大为必跟随链接，但目标根/父路径无物理路径租约仍有竞争。docs渲染失败亦只warn，卡片状态完成不代表材料齐全。",

        "question": "角色、模型与人类交接分别依什么机制？",
        "answer": "角色手册通过systemPrompt段和spawn persona注入，成员路线读班底modelRoute，无覆盖时pin宿主当前默认，provider与spawn/fork传输分开。这是可配置多角色协作，不是自带注册多个官方preset，也没有证明不同模型一定增益。角色文本插值转义减少{{变量}}破坏装配，模型仍可误解任务。\n\n/eteam真实用户命令开角色构建流程；子Agent问答通过eteams_ask_user调用宿主userQuestions，按用户是否看提问子会话/主对话是否在线选择落点，先落pending意图再等待答复，答后存answered，失败cancel并返回degraded提示。可追踪问答归属比散落聊天强，但依赖宿主userQuestions真实人类输入/目标授权；问询列表与skip本身不证明批准。\n\n能力缺口报告的risk/verdict由遇拒子Agent自己判，宿主做确定性高风险拒绝、常设路线和同操作去重再落表，并非独立模型二次审查/自动可信权限提升。必须把建议换法/路线治理与底层宿主权限分开；本轮只核模块职责和核心选择路径，未完整审计所有风险分类规则。",

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "<div align=\"center\">\n\n\n# ETeams\n\n**让 AI 组成一支真正的团队。**\n\n领队拆解目标，成员接力执行 —— DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体团队协作插件。\n\n[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.2.18-4B6BFB?style=flat-square)](package.json)\n[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-3DA639?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)\n[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933?style=flat-square)](package.json)\n[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-6E56CF?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)\n\n</div>\n\n\n\n## 这是什么\n\nETeams 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上「一支团队」：你把目标丢给**领队**，领队把目标拆成任务、按**执行链**派给**成员**，每个成员在自己的子会话里独立干活，进度、失败、决策实时可见。\n\n不是「一个大模型假装多个人」，而是真实的多会话协作，你可以自由调度成员，并给每个成员不同的模型。\n\n- **包名** `dsh-eteams`，插件 id `eteams`，双端单包（宿主端 + 浏览器端）。\n- **自包含**：构建产物已内联全部依赖，无运行时安装负担；状态存本机 SQLite（内置 `node:sqlite`），不联网、不上传。\n\n## 三步上手\n\n| 步骤         | 做什么                                                                  |\n| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| **1 · 添加成员** | `/eteam` 面试式生成角色手册，落进全局角色库 —— 每个角色就是一张岗位卡。 |\n| **2 · 组件团队** | 面板「团队」页从角色库挑人进班子，指定一人为领队。                      |\n| **3 · 创建任务** | 对话里说清目标 → 领队拆解、你批准 → 自动派发执行，全程在面板围观。      |\n\n## 特色\n\n### 1. 定制 system 角色\n\n![system](./pic/system.png)\n\n你可以通过角色中的 system 来定制你的所有会话， 这样你就有一只专属的猫娘助手了\n\n### 2. 为每个角色设置不同的会话模型\n\n![model](./pic/model.png)\n\n你可以为团队中的每个成员设置不同的会话模型，让不同的模型在任务中流转\n\n\n## 界面展示\n![看板](./pic/看板.png)\n![角色](./pic/角色.png)\n![团队](./pic/团队.png)\n![任务](./pic/任务.png)\n![任务进度](./pic/任务进度.png)\n## 安装\n\n**方式一：插件市场（推荐）**\n\n在 DeepSeek Harness 插件市场搜索 **ETeams**，一键安装后重启应用。\n\n**方式二：命令行**\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-eteams\n```\n\n**方式三：本地源码（开发调试）**\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/2507483326/dsh-eteams.git && cd dsh-eteams\npnpm install && pnpm build\ndsh plugin --profile desktop add .\n```\n\n安装后核对装配结果，并重载客户端：\n\n```bash\ndsh --profile desktop --dump-config\n```\n\n"

      "path": "cordis.patch.yml",
      "content": "# dsh-eteams bundle patch: mounts the eteams plugin into the host composition\n# of a dsh profile. The plugin injects tools/subagents/agents/systemPrompt and\n# registers the full `eteams_*` captain+member tool face (team lifecycle,\n# execution chains, mailboxes), and its client bundle adds the 团队 tab and the\n# composer 团队 button.\n#\n# Install: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <this package>` (npm or a local\n# path). The `dsh plugin` command pnpm-installs the package into the profile\n# and reconciles it into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer list.\n- insert:\n    - id: eteams\n      # Node-resolvable package name — must stay in sync with package.json\n      # `name`. Quoted because `@` is a reserved indicator in YAML and cannot\n      # open a plain scalar (kept quoted for uniformity with the reference).\n      name: 'dsh-eteams'\n      config:\n        # 状态根（用户迭代 2026-09-04 全局单库）：绝对路径 = 所有工作区共用\n        # 这一个根——一个 eteams.db、一份成员库、一份用量台账；相对路径 =\n        # per-workspace（<workspace>/<stateDir>，旧口径）。\n        stateDir: C:/Users/epat/.eteams\n        # Task working directory root: `<workspace>/<workRoot>/<主任务号>-slug/`\n        # (一个主任务一个目录：留言板.md + <任务号>-slug.纪要.md + 计划/ + 文档/).\n        workRoot: teams\n        # Hard cap on concurrently existing members per team.\n        maxMembers: 20\n        # Same-member auto-retry budget before a task fails hard (D6).\n        maxRetries: 3\n        # Provider used to spawn member subagents ('spawn' or 'fork').\n        memberProvider: spawn\n"

      "content": "/**\n * Caller identity resolution (docs/05.8): every tool execution resolves the\n * calling agent into captain-of-team or member-of-team before touching state.\n * Non-team agents get an actionable error.\n *\n * @module dsh-eteams/tools/identity\n */\nimport type { Agent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent';\nimport type { TaskMemberRecord, TeamState } from '../model/types.js';\nimport { listTeams, findTeamByCaptain } from '../state/store.js';\nimport { getSessionTeamId } from '../runtime/sessionTeam.js';\nimport { captainChildTeamOf } from '../runtime/captainChildRegistry.js';\nimport { locateAgentTeam } from '../runtime/workspaces.js';\nimport { leaderRowOf } from '../runtime/notifier.js';\nimport {\n  captainActor,\n  memberActor,\n  stateRootOf,\n  ETeamsError,\n  type RuntimeContext,\n  type RuntimeEnv,\n} from '../runtime/base.js';\nimport type { ETeamsResolvedConfig } from '../config.js';\nimport type { Actor } from '../model/types.js';\n\n/** Captain caller: leads exactly one active team. */\nexport interface CaptainCaller {\n  kind: 'captain';\n  team: TeamState;\n  actor: Actor;\n}\n\n/** Member caller: one exact task replica row (taskMemberId + employeeId) of one team. */\nexport interface MemberCaller {\n  kind: 'member';\n  team: TeamState;\n  member: TaskMemberRecord;\n  actor: Actor;\n}\n\nexport type Caller = CaptainCaller | MemberCaller;\n\n/** Build a runtime env for one agent execution. */\nexport function envForAgent(\n  config: ETeamsResolvedConfig,\n  ctx: RuntimeContext,\n  agent: Agent | undefined,\n  signal?: AbortSignal,\n): RuntimeEnv {\n  if (!agent) throw new ETeamsError('无法识别调用者（exec.agent 缺失）');\n  const sessionId = String(agent.id ?? '');\n  const cwd = agent.session?.header?.cwd ?? process.cwd();\n  // 跨工作区团队对齐（docs/26）：band/面板按注册表全工作区定位，工具环境\n  // 在此对齐——本会话身份对应的团队若在别的注册工作区（会话项目目录 ≠\n  // 团队工作区），env 重指到团队所在工作区：**状态根**以团队为准（任务目录与\n  // 文档渲染自 2026-09-16 起按任务自己的 work_dir 走，见 runtime/docs）；\n  // resolveCaller 随后在重指后的根上按同一优先级解析。\n  const located = locateAgentTeam(\n    config,\n    ctx,\n    sessionId,\n    cwd,\n    getSessionTeamId(sessionId) ?? captainChildTeamOf(sessionId),\n  );\n  return {\n    ctx,\n    config,\n    workspace: located?.workspacePath ?? cwd,\n    sessionId,\n    signal,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Resolve the calling agent into a team identity. Members are matched by\n * their durable child session id (`task_members.session_id === agent.id`，\n * 副本行执行会话即身份凭证；v7 按工号/行 id 精确到任务副本行，R1 离职截断\n * 见成员分支注释).\n *\n * 绑定优先（docs/26 用户迭代 2026-09-03）：输入栏「团队」弹层的显式选择\n * 是用户最近的意图——凡绑定了团队的会话，按该团队的领队身份行动，团队\n * 建在哪个对话不再重要（原「他队」死路已撤）。绑定先于任务快照匹配：\n * 一个会话既领队 A 队又绑定 B 队时，工具作用于 B（弹层选择即最新意图）。\n *\n * 领队子代理（docs/26 用户迭代 2026-09-03）：dispatch 派发的持续子代理\n * 经 `captainChildTeamOf` 注册表命中——它的 eteams_* 调用一律按该团队\n * 领队解析（含跨工作区重指，envForAgent 同一 fallback）。注册先于任务\n * 快照匹配：注册表命中的是真子代理；宿主重启后注册表丢失，退回领队行\n * session_id 匹配（领队子代理会话即身份，v6 落列）。\n */\nexport async function resolveCaller(env: RuntimeEnv, agent: Agent): Promise<Caller> {\n  const sessionId = String(agent.id ?? '');\n  if (sessionId === '') throw new ETeamsError('无法识别调用者身份（会话 id 为空）');\n  const root = stateRootOf(env);\n  const teams = await listTeams(root);\n  // 绑定常驻（用户迭代 2026-09-10 锁定语义）：绑定不再随消息消费，凡绑定\n  // 会话的 eteams_* 调用恒按绑定团队解析（sessionTeam.ts）。\n  const boundTeamId = getSessionTeamId(sessionId);\n  if (boundTeamId !== undefined) {\n    const bound = teams.find((t) => String(t.id) === boundTeamId);\n    if (bound) return { kind: 'captain', team: bound, actor: captainActor(bound) };\n  }\n  const childTeamId = captainChildTeamOf(sessionId);\n  if (childTeamId !== undefined) {\n    const childTeam = teams.find((t) => String(t.id) === childTeamId);\n    if (childTeam) return { kind: 'captain', team: childTeam, actor: captainActor(childTeam) };\n  }\n  // 领队主会话身份（v6 派生）：任一任务行 main_session_id 快照命中；无任务\n  // 团队退建队事件留痕（findTeamByCaptain，建队后首个任务落地前）。\n  const asCaptain = await findTeamByCaptain(root, sessionId);\n  if (asCaptain) return { kind: 'captain', team: asCaptain, actor: captainActor(asCaptain) };\n  // 领队子代理会话（领队行 session_id）：注册表丢失后的冷恢复身份。\n  const asLeaderChild = teams.find((t) => leaderRowOf(t)?.sessionId === sessionId);\n  if (asLeaderChild) {\n    return { kind: 'captain', team: asLeaderChild, actor: captainActor(asLeaderChild) };\n  }\n  // 成员身份走副本行（session_id 即成员子会话 id）。R1 离职截断：工牌\n  // （班底行）已删的副本行不再解析出成员身份——其存活子会话的工面就地失效\n  // （工具层按 caller 缺失拒绝），防止离职成员继续 claim/读箱。\n  for (const team of teams) {\n    const row = team.taskMembers.find(\n      (r) =>\n        r.sessionId === sessionId &&\n        (r.employeeId === null || team.members.some((m) => m.employeeId === r.employeeId)),\n    );\n    if (row) {\n      // 领队副本行（随大任务生灭的领队子会话，用户迭代 2026-09-08）按\n      // captain 解析——它不是干活的成员，是本任务的主持者。\n      if (row.isLeader === true) {\n        return { kind: 'captain', team, actor: captainActor(team) };\n      }\n      return { kind: 'member', team, member: row, actor: memberActor(row) };\n    }\n  }\n  throw new ETeamsError(\n    '当前会话不在任何 eteams 团队中',\n    '领队用 eteams_create_team 建队；成员由领队拉入团队',\n  );\n}\n\n/** Shared listTeams re-export for tool factories. */\nexport { listTeams };\n"

`task.suspended{via:'session.dead'}`）。**宽限期**（默认 60s，按\n * `claimed_time ?? created_time` 起算）避开 spawn / 冷恢复途中的短暂不在册，防误杀。\n *\n * 不做常驻轮询（用户 2026-09-18 拍板）：进程内的「用户点停止 / 回合异常结束」都有\n * `turn/end` from '@deepseek-ai/cordis';\nimport type { ETeamsResolvedConfig } from '../config.js';\nimport type { TeamState } from '../model/types.js';\nimport { listInFlightAttempts, readTeamSync, type { collectRoots } from './workspaces.js';\n\n/**\n * 启动快扫时刻（ms）：apply() 执行的瞬间工作区注册表往往还没就绪，`collectRoots`\n * 返回空 → 装机时那次立即 sweep 会空跑，只能干等（实测重启后最长要等满一整轮）。\n * 故启动后几秒内补几轮，注册表一就绪即生效（用户 启动对账一次即可，无需常驻轮询。\n */\nconst BOOT_SWEEP_DELAYS_MS = [1_000, 3_000, 6_000, 10_000];\n/** 宽限期：在办时长不足此值不判死（给 spawn/冷恢复留窗口；用户 2026-09-18 拍板 60s）。 */\nconst GRACE_MS = 60_000;\n\nlet logger: RuntimeLogger | undefined;\nlet bootTimers: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>[] = [];\nlet lastWarnAt = 0;\n\nfunction warnThrottled(message: string): void {\n  const at = Date.now();\n  if (at - lastWarnAt < 60_000) return;\n  lastWarnAt = at;\n  logger?.warn(message);\n}\n\n/** 宿主活 agent 注册表的最小面（inject `agents`，cordis Service）。 */\ninterface LiveAgentsFace {\n  list(): { id: unknown }[];\n}\n\n/**\n * 当前活 agent 的会话 id 集合（宿主权威存活信号）：重启后必然为空。方法**带\n * 接收者**调用（cordis 服务方法依赖 `this`）；服务缺失/异常一律当空集合。\n */\nexport function liveAgentIds(ctx: unknown): Set<string> {\n  const agents = (ctx as { agents?: LiveAgentsFace }\n}\n\n/** 在办尝试的执行会话 id（副本行 id 优先，旧数据退按名兜底）——空串 = 未起会话。 */\nfunction sessionIdOfAttempt(team: TeamState, row: InFlightAttemptRow): string {\n  const byId =\n    row.taskMemberId !== null\n      ? '';\n}\n\n/** One reconciliation pass（导出供测试直接驱动；返回本轮挂起的小任务数）。 */\nexport async function reconcileDeadSessions(\n  ctx: Context,\n  config: ETeamsResolvedConfig,\n  options: { graceMs?: number; now?: number } = {},\n): Promise<number> {\n  const live = liveAgentIds(ctx);\n  const now = options.now ?? Date.now();\n  const graceMs = options.graceMs ?? GRACE_MS;\n  let paused = 0;\n  for (const { root, workspacePath } of collectRoots(ctx, config)) {\n    let rows: InFlightAttemptRow[];\n    try {\n      rows = listInFlightAttempts(root);\n    } catch (error) {\n      warnThrottled(`eteams reconcile: 读取在办尝试失败（跳过本轮）：${String(error)}`);\n      continue;\n    }\n    if (rows.length === 0) continue;\n    const byTeam = new Map<number, InFlightAttemptRow[]>();\n    for (const row of rows) {\n      const bucket = byTeam.get(row.teamId);\n      if (bucket === undefined) byTeam.set(row.teamId, [row]);\n      else bucket.push(row);\n    }\n    const env: RuntimeEnv = {\n      ctx: ctx as unknown as RuntimeContext,\n      config,\n      workspace: workspacePath,\n    };\n    for (const [teamId, attempts] of byTeam) {\n      const team = readTeamSync(root, teamId);\n      if (team === undefined) continue;\n      for (const row of attempts) {\n        // 宽限期：刚派出/冷恢复在途的会话可能还没在册，不判死。\n        if (now - row.since < graceMs) continue;\n        const sessionId = sessionIdOfAttempt(team, row);\n        // 会话仍活着（含驻留 idle 的子代理）→ 真有工作在办，不动。\n        if (sessionId !== '' && live.has(sessionId)) continue;\n        try {\n          const hit = await pauseTaskOnDeadSession(env, teamId, row.taskId);\n          if (hit !== undefined) paused += 1;\n        } catch (error) {\n          warnThrottled(`eteams reconcile: 挂起任务失败：${String(error)}`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return paused;\n}\n\n/** Install the dead-session reconciler (root-scope, index.ts apply, 启动一次). */\nexport function installDeadSessionReconciler(ctx: Context, config: ETeamsResolvedConfig): void {\n  logger = (ctx as unknown as { logger: RuntimeLogger }).logger;\n  clearBootTimers();\n  const run = (): void => {\n    void reconcileDeadSessions(ctx, config).catch((error) =>\n      warnThrottled(`eteams reconcile: 对账失败（不影响会话）：${String(error)}`),\n    );\n  };\n  // 启动立即跑一轮（重启前的会话全不在册）；此时 workspaceRegistry 往往未就绪 →\n  // collectRoots 返回空、本轮 no-op，故紧接着补几轮快扫（见 BOOT_SWEEP_DELAYS_MS），\n  // 注册表一就绪即生效。此后不再排期——进程内的中断由中断观察者按事件处置。\n  run();\n  for (const delay of BOOT_SWEEP_DELAYS_MS) {\n    const handle = setTimeout(run, delay);\n    // 绝不影响宿主退出：宿主进程不因这些 timer 被拖着不走。\n    (handle as { unref?: () => void }).unref?.();\n    bootTimers.push(handle);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction clearBootTimers(): void {\n  for (const handle of bootTimers) clearTimeout(handle);\n  bootTimers = [];\n}\n\n/** Tests-only：停启动快扫 timer、清模块级 logger 与节流窗口（vitest 隔离）。 */\nexport function resetReconcilerForTests(): void {\n  clearBootTimers();\n  logger = undefined;\n  lastWarnAt = 0;\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * 子代理用户问答（eteams_ask_user 运行时编排，2026-09-10 统一）：eteam 的\n * 子代理（领队/成员/构建师）需要向用户弹问答时一律——\n * ① 审计行落 ask_questions（status=pending）：面板「待问答」徽标的数据源；\n * ② ctx.userQuestions.ask() 弹**DeepSeek 原生问答弹窗**并阻塞——目标按\n *    「用户当前所在会话」判定（presence 心跳，见 runAskUser）：用户正看着\n *    提问子代理自己的对话 → 就地弹；否则弹提问子代理所属的**主对话**（任务\n *    锚/构建父会话记录的主会话；主对话代理是活运行时根，原生弹窗直接接管\n *    它的输入区，侧边栏琥珀点常驻未决标记）；主对话不在线（CALLER_NOT_LIVE）\n *    或弹窗被拒时退回提问子代理自己的对话再试一次（子代理也是 continuable\n *    运行时根，用户打开该会话即可作答）；答完同回合继续，答案同步返回；\n * ③ 构建师调用时宿主自动把答案写回构建会话（answerBuildInterview，覆写幂\n *    等）——构建子代理无须再 eteams_build_report(answers)；\n * ④ 两次弹窗都被拒/服务缺失 → 行转 cancelled，返回 degradeHint（把问题写\n *    进汇报文本直接问用户的既有兜底）。\n *\n * 宿主不做更多会话路由：弹窗是原生组件，弹在哪由传入的 agent 决定；除\n * presence 命中就地在提问会话弹、否则主对话优先、自身兜底外不引入第三目标，\n * 也不唤醒任何对话的 LLM。\n * （旧转交路径——presence 判定、steer 主会话代弹、eteams_ask_answer 回收、\n * wakeAskingChild 唤醒——随统一整体退役，2026-09-10。）\n *\n * @module dsh-eteams/runtime/askUser\n */\nimport {\n  answerAskSync,\n  cancelAskSync,\n  newAskId,\n  normalizeAskAnswer,\n  insertAskSync,\n  recordAskDeliverySync,\n  type AskAnswer,\n  type AskQuestion,\n} from '../state/asks.js';\nimport { stateRootOf, type RuntimeEnv } from './base.js';\nimport { answerBuildInterview, readBuildPresence, readBuildSession } from './roleBuilder.js';\n\n/** 调用者视图（工具层从 resolveCaller 结果投影；runtime 不反向依赖 tools）。 */\nexport interface AskCallerView {\n  /** 所属团队 id（0 = 无团队桶——构建会话等对话外调用者）。 */\n  teamId: number;\n  /** 提问子代理会话 id。 */\n  askingSessionId: string;\n  /** 展示名：成员名 / '领队' / '角色构建师'。 */\n  askingName: string;\n  askingKind: 'captain' | 'member' | 'conversation';\n  /** 相关大任务 id（可选，落问答单供面板定位）。 */\n  mainTaskId?: number;\n  /**\n   * 弹窗目标主对话会话 id（可选）：提问子代理所属任务锚的主会话 / 构建父\n   * 会话。主会话亲自问（绑定身份）不带此字段——它自己就是主对话。\n   */\n  mainSessionId?: string;\n}\n\n/** ctx.userQuestions 服务面（结构子集；dsh-user-questions 的 ask 契约）。 */\ninterface UserQuestionsFace {\n  ask(request: {\n    questions: AskQuestion[];\n    agent?: unknown;\n    signal?: AbortSignal;\n  }): Promise<{ answers: AskAnswer[] }>;\n}\n\n/** Defensive lookup（cordis 4 未声明 inject 的服务属性访问会抛；吞错降级）。 */\nfunction userQuestionsOf(ctx: unknown): UserQuestionsFace | undefined {\n  try {\n    const direct = (ctx as { userQuestions?: unknown }).userQuestions;\n    if (direct !== undefined && direct !== null) return direct as UserQuestionsFace;\n    const got = (ctx as { get?: (key: string) => unknown }).get?.('userQuestions');\n    return got !== undefined && got !== null ? (got as UserQuestionsFace) : undefined;\n  } catch {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n}\n\n/** 主对话的活代理（assignment/notifier 同款 agents.get 取活实例；注册表\n * 按会话 id 命中 = 该对话窗口在线）。缺失/结构未知 → undefined。 */\nfunction liveAgentOf(ctx: unknown, sessionId: string | undefined): unknown {\n  if (sessionId === undefined || sessionId === '') return undefined;\n  try {\n    const live = (ctx as { agents?: { get?: (id: string) => unknown } }).agents?.get?.(sessionId);\n    return live ?? undefined;\n  } catch {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n}\n\n/** runAskUser 的两种结局：self=弹窗已拿到答案（同回合继续）；\n * degraded=问答不可用，调用方把问题写进文本直接问用户。 */\nexport type AskOutcome =\n  | { mode: 'self'; askId: string; answers: AskAnswer[] }\n  | { mode: 'degraded'; askId?: string; reason: string };\n\n/**\n * 执行一次用户问答（统一路径，2026-09-10）：落审计行 → 主对话弹原生问答\n * 弹窗（阻塞；主对话不在线退回提问会话自身）→ 答案落行回传。主对话代理经\n * agents.get 取活实例（弹窗服务按 agent 鉴权：必须恰是注册表里的活运行时\n * 根，否则 CALLER_NOT_LIVE）。弹窗服务缺失在落单前拦下（不留孤儿行）；两\n * 次弹窗都被拒/报错把行转 cancelled 后降级。\n */\nexport async function runAskUser(\n  env: RuntimeEnv,\n  caller: AskCallerView,\n  questions: AskQuestion[],\n  options: { agent?: unknown } = {},\n): Promise<AskOutcome> {\n  const root = stateRootOf(env);\n  const service = userQuestionsOf(env.ctx);\n  if (service === undefined) {\n    return { mode: 'degraded', reason: '弹窗服务不可用（宿主未提供 userQuestions）' };\n  }\n\n  // 弹窗目标按「用户当前所在会话」判定（用户 2026-09-12「判断用户当前在哪个\n  // 会话，如果在当前会话就弹当前会话，不在就弹主会话」）：presence 心跳命中\n  // 提问会话自身（用户正看着这个子对话）→ 就地弹；否则弹主对话（用户通常在\n  // 主对话里），主对话不在线退回提问会话自身。\n  const presence = readBuildPresence(root);\n  const userInAskingSession = presence !== null && presence.sessionId === caller.askingSessionId;\n  const mainAgent = liveAgentOf(env.ctx, caller.mainSessionId);\n  // 弹窗主对话优先（用户 2026-09-12）：用户不在提问子会话、且主对话有活代理\n  // 时弹主对话，否则弹提问子会话自身。primaryIsMain 决定落点会话的记录（v14）。\n  const primaryIsMain =\n    !userInAskingSession && mainAgent !== undefined && mainAgent !== options.agent;\n  const primary = primaryIsMain ? mainAgent : options.agent;\n\n  const askId = newAskId();\n  const now = Date.now();\n  // 落点意图**先落库**（v14）：弹窗是阻塞的，面板需在待答期间就能拿到落点去\n  // 跳转，不能等答完才写；主对话不在线退回提问子会话时再由 recordAskDeliverySync\n  // 更正为提问会话。\n  const deliverySessionId = primaryIsMain\n    ? (caller.mainSessionId ?? caller.askingSessionId)\n    : caller.askingSessionId;\n  // 就地弹也落审计行（面板徽标的数据源）：pending → answered。\n  insertAskSync(root, {\n    askId,\n    teamId: caller.teamId,\n    askingSessionId: caller.askingSessionId,\n    askingName: caller.askingName,\n    askingKind: caller.askingKind,\n    ...(caller.mainTaskId !== undefined ? { mainTaskId: caller.mainTaskId } : {}),\n    questions,\n    status: 'pending',\n    // relaySessionId 审计留档：恒等于提问会话自身（旧转交时代的字段，保留\n    // 兼容历史行读端）；v14 弹窗实际落点另落 delivery_session_id/is_main。\n    relaySessionId: caller.askingSessionId,\n    deliverySessionId,\n    deliveryIsMain: primaryIsMain,\n    createdAt: now,\n    updatedAt: now,\n  });\n  const askOnce = (agent: unknown): Promise<{ answers: AskAnswer[] }> =>\n    service.ask({\n      questions,\n      ...(agent !== undefined ? { agent } : {}),\n      ...(env.signal !== undefined ? { signal: env.signal } : {}),\n    });\n  try {\n    let reply: { answers: AskAnswer[] };\n    try {\n      reply = await askOnce(primary);\n    } catch (primaryError) {\n      // 主对话不在线（CALLER_NOT_LIVE）/弹窗被拒 → 退回提问子代理自己的\n      // 对话再试一次（侧边栏未决标记仍引导用户）；同目标或无兜底则原样上抛。\n      if (primary === options.agent || options.agent === undefined) throw primaryError;\n      reply = await askOnce(options.agent);\n      // 退回提问子会话成功：更正落点记录（面板据此跳到子会话作答）。\n      recordAskDeliverySync(root, askId, caller.askingSessionId, false);\n    }\n    const answers = reply.answers\n      .map(normalizeAskAnswer)\n      .filter((a): a is AskAnswer => a !== undefined);\n    answerAskSync(root, askId, answers);\n    // 构建师分支（统一问答 2026-09-10）：构建子代理的问答由宿主自动写回\n    // 构建会话——它同回合拿到 answers 继续起草，不再自己 build_report(answers)。\n    // 判据与旧桥接一致（builderChildId 严格相等）；构建会话已终态/无访谈态\n    // 时静默跳过（问答单照常回收，弹窗答案仍回传给调用者）。\n    const buildSession = readBuildSession(root);\n    if (buildSession?.builderChildId === caller.askingSessionId) {\n      try {\n        await answerBuildInterview(\n          root,\n          answers.map((a) => ({\n            id: a.id,\n            choice: a.custom !== undefined && a.custom !== '' ? `${a.custom}` : a.selected,\n          })),\n        );\n      } catch {\n        // 无访谈态/已终态：不拦问答返回。\n      }\n    }\n    return { mode: 'self', askId, answers };\n  } catch (error) {\n    cancelAskSync(root, askId);\n    return {\n      mode: 'degraded',\n      askId,\n      reason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n    };\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * 能力缺口的运行时编排（v16；docs/subagentCapabilityGap.md）。\n *\n * 分工（与设计稿的一处偏离，记在此处以免误读）：设计稿写「Layer 1 分级＝宿主\n * 调一次模型」，但 `RuntimeContext` 里**没有 llm 面**——宿主调不了模型。而分级\n * 要判的恰是「换做法能不能过」，**只有刚撞到拒绝的那个子代理知道**（它试过哪些\n * 替代）。所以分级由上报方自己做（口径写在 `eteams_report_gap` 的 description\n * 里），宿主负责三件它才做得了的事：\n *\n * 1. **Layer 0 确定性预筛**（本模块，零模型调用）：高风险直接拒、命中常设路线\n *    直接按路线走、同操作已有 open 缺口去重——都依据宿主已知事实（argv、\n *    工作区根、路线表），不猜。\n * 2. **校验与落表**（state/gaps 的落表闸：high 拒收、why 必挂验收标准、argv 必填）。\n * 3. **结构性活动的原子落地**（「定路线 + 沉淀常设路线」同一事务，见\n *    {@link applyGapRoute}）。\n *\n * 本模块只做这三件，**不碰**消息与弹窗：唤醒领队是调用方照既有纪律走\n * `eteams_send_message`，问用户走 `eteams_ask_user`（人面前那一段复用问答表）。\n *\n * @module dsh-eteams/runtime/gaps\n */\nimport type { Agent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent';\nimport type { ContentBlock } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm';\nimport type { SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session';\nimport type { RuntimeContext, RuntimeEnv } from './base.js';\nimport { stateRootFor } from './base.js';\nimport type { TeamState } from '../model/types.js';\nimport {\n  insertGapInTx,\n  newGapId,\n  operationClassOf,\n  readGapSync,\n  readOpenGapsSync,\n  resolveRoutingMemoSync,\n  setGapRouteInTx,\n  upsertRoutingMemoInTx,\n  type CapabilityGapRecord,\n  type GapDecidedBy,\n  type GapOperation,\n  type GapRisk,\n  type GapRoute,\n} from '../state/gaps.js';\nimport { withTeamTx } from '../state/store.js';\n\n/**\n * 本模块只用到 env 的这两项（状态根推导 + 工作区根归一）。窄化之后不依赖\n * ctx，单测可直接构造，不必铺 RuntimeContext 全形状。\n */\nexport type GapRuntimeEnv = Pick<RuntimeEnv, 'config' | 'workspace'>;\n\n/** 上报方的分级判定（口径见 `eteams_report_gap` 的 description）。 */\nexport type GapVerdict = 'self-resolvable' | 'report-gap' | 'refuse';\n\n/**\n * `undefined` when no such\n * team（键可以是 team_id 数字、team_name 或整数串）。\n */\nexport async function readTeam(\n  stateRoot: string,\n  teamId: TeamKey,\n): Promise<TeamState | undefined> {\n  return readTeamSync(stateRoot, teamId);\n}\n\n/** Synchronous read used inside continuable setup hooks (must not await). */\nexport function readTeamSync(stateRoot: string, teamId: TeamKey): TeamState | undefined {\n  const db = getDb(stateRoot);\n  ensureWorkspaceReady(stateRoot, db);\n  const row = selectTeamRow(db, teamId);\n  if (row === undefined) return undefined;\n  return assembleTeam(db, row);\n}\n\n/** 一行已处置决策（看板「决策面板」『已决策』历史读端）。 */\nexport interface ResolvedDecisionRow {\n  id: number;\n  taskId: number;\n  error: string;\n  retryCount: number;\n  choice: string | null;\n  note: string | null;\n  resolvedAt: number | null;\n  createdAt: number;\n}\n\n/**\n * 最近已处置决策（decisions.status='resolved'，处置时刻降序、最新在前）。\n * 历史全量留库（writeTeamInTx 只删 open 行），读端按 limit 限量——面板只回看\n * 最近 N 条。看板「决策面板」『已决策』数据源。\n */\nexport function readRecentResolvedDecisionsSync(\n  stateRoot: string,\n  teamId: TeamKey,\n  limit: number,\n): ResolvedDecisionRow[] {\n  const db = getDb(stateRoot);\n  ensureWorkspaceReady(stateRoot, db);\n  const id = resolveTeamId(db, teamId);\n  if (id === undefined) return [];\n  const rows = db\n    .prepare(\n      'SELECT decision_id, task_id, error, retry_count, choice, note, resolved_time, created_time ' +\n        \"FROM decisions WHERE team_id = ? AND status = 'resolved' \" +\n        'ORDER BY COALESCE(resolved_time, created_time) DESC, decision_id DESC LIMIT ?',\n    )\n    .all(id, limit) as Array<{\n    decision_id: number;\n    task_id: number;\n    error: string;\n    retry_count: number;\n    choice: string | null;\n    note: string | null;\n    resolved_time: number | null;\n    created_time: number;\n  }>;\n  return rows.map((row) => ({\n    id: row.decision_id,\n    taskId: row.task_id,\n    error: row.error,\n    retryCount: row.retry_count,\n    choice: row.choice,\n    note: row.note,\n    resolvedAt: row.resolved_time,\n    createdAt: row.created_time,\n  }));\n}\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 写端：一个同步事务里 DELETE 团队行 + 带原号重 INSERT（docs/35 §2）。\n// 只重写 TeamState 支撑的 6 张表——events / mail_messages /\n// task_status_changes 只插入不改写，不属于快照。\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/** 快照全量落库（供 withTeamTx 内调用；勿在其外叠层开启事务）。 */\nexport function writeTeamInTx(tx: TeamTx, state: TeamState): void {\n  const { db } = tx;\n  const now = tx.now;\n  state.updatedAt = now;\n  const teamId = state.id;\n  db.prepare('DELETE FROM team WHERE team_id = ?').run(teamId);\n  db.prepare(\n    'INSERT INTO team (team_id, team_name, has_leader, created_time, update_time) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n  ).run(teamId, state.name, state.hasLeader ? JSON.stringify(a.result.changedPaths) : null,\n        a.error ?? null,\n        a.claimedAt ?? null,\n        a.endedAt ?? null,\n        a.createdAt,\n        a.endedAt ?? a.createdAt,\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  // decisions：open 行整删重建；resolved 行一经写入即留档（看板「决策面板」\n  // 『已决策』历史数据源）——只删 open，resolved 行不参与 DELETE，重载后虽不\n  // 再进内存（loadTasks 只读 open）也留在库里，不被后续写入冲掉。\n  db.prepare(\"DELETE FROM decisions WHERE team_id = ?       "content": "/**\n * Process-local async mutexes (docs/09.3): per-team serialization. Locks are\n * keyed promise chains — no cross-process file locking (single-writer\n * assumption, NFR-03). Tails are retained per key (bounded by the number of\n * teams ever seen in this process); a throwing fn never poisons the chain.\n *\n * @module dsh-eteams/state/lock\n */\n\n/** Keyed promise-chain mutex registry. */\nexport class LockMap {\n  private readonly tails = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();\n\n  /**\n   * Run `fn` while holding the lock for `key`; concurrent callers queue FIFO.\n   * @param key - lock key (`team:<root>:<id>`).\n   * @param fn - the critical section.\n   */\n  async withLock<T>(key: string, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {\n    const previous = this.tails.get(key) ?? Promise.resolve();\n    const gated = previous.then(\n      () => undefined,\n      () => undefined,\n    );\n    const release = (async () => {\n      await gated;\n      return await fn();\n    })();\n    // Tail settles regardless of fn's outcome so the chain never rejects.\n    const tail = release.then(\n      () => undefined,\n      () => undefined,\n    );\n    this.tails.set(key, tail);\n    return release;\n  }\n\n  /** Test helper: number of tracked lock keys. */\n  get size(): number {\n    return this.tails.size;\n  }\n}\n\n/** The process-wide lock registry used by the runtime. */\nexport const locks = new LockMap();\n\n/** Per-team serialization key (docs/09.3). */\nexport function teamLockKey(stateRoot: string, teamId: string): string {\n  return `team:${stateRoot}:${teamId}`;\n}\n"

      "path": "src/host/commands/eteam.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * /eteam 命令（docs/19.4, D18）：新增成员 · 角色构建师的命令面入口。斜杠\n * 输入本身不会到达模型，handler 把激活消息（`eTeam --add-people …`）显式\n * steer 到接收 agent 上；门禁 + 受理即写盘 + 持续构建子代理受理派发\n * （startBuilderChild）的编排随 handler 走，命令面一次性 UX 文本（busy/\n * 降级 notice）留在本文件。\n *\n * @module dsh-eteams/commands/eteam\n */\nimport { createUserMessage } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm';\nimport type { Agent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent';\nimport type { CommandDefinition } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands';\nimport type { SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session';\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis';\nimport type { ETeamsResolvedConfig } from '../config.js';\nimport {\n  deliverNotice,\n  resumeOptionsOf,\n  type RuntimeContext,\n} from '../runtime/base.js';\nimport {\n  hasBuildSessionFile,\n  readBuildSession,\n  reportBuildProgress,\n  cancelBuildSession,\n} from '../runtime/roleBuilder.js';\nimport { rootForWrites } from '../runtime/webui.js';\nimport { startBuilderChild } from '../runtime/builderPhases.js';\nimport { annotateBuildSession, appendEngageDiag } from '../runtime/roleBuilder.js';\nimport { ACTIVATION_PREFIX } from '../prompts/system/roleBuilder.js';\n\n/** The /eteam slash command name (DSH command names are lowercase, docs/19.4). */\nexport const ADD_PEOPLE_COMMAND = 'eteam';\n\n/** The bare requirement body used when the invocation carries no arguments. */\nexport const ADD_PEOPLE_BARE_BODY = '我需要创建一个成员 【成员名称】，它的职责是【职责】。';\n\n/**\n * Compose the activation message steered by the /eteam command: normalize a\n * leading `--add-people` (the command hint repeats it), fall back to the\n * bare template body, and prepend the activation marker.\n */\nexport function buildActivationMessage(rawInput: string): string {\n  let rest = rawInput.trim();\n  if (rest.startsWith('--add-people')) {\n    rest = rest.slice('--add-people'.length).trim();\n  }\n  return `${ACTIVATION_PREFIX} ${rest === '' ? ADD_PEOPLE_BARE_BODY : rest}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Engage a conversationally blank session with a short plugin notice after\n * the build was accepted (docs/19.16 空会话唤醒，用户反馈 2026-09-04)。\n *\n * 斜杠命令只落 command/run + command/done 两条 log-only 记录——既不是\n * prompt 也不开 turn，宿主的 blank→engaged 相位机（blank 仅由 turn/start\n * 翻转；命令记录、plan/goal 等插件事件都不开 turn）永远不翻：主窗口停在\n * 未开始屏，对话视图渲染不出，/eteam 命令节点与对话内构建卡片不挂载，\n * 卡片的「发送即跳转」无从发生——构建在后台完全隐形地跑，用户只见「子\n * agent 创建了，界面却没进对话」。steer 一条 plugin notice 让 idle driver\n * 立即开 turn：宿主 running 位翻转 → 客户端 blankBit 清零 → 对话视图出现\n * → 命令节点渲染 → 构建卡片挂载并接管落地（20s 窗口自动跳转照常生效）。\n * 开过 turn 的会话不加这一回合——避免每次 /eteam 多出一段应答噪音。\n */\nexport async function steerEngageNotice(\n  ctx: Context,\n  agent: Agent,\n  stateRoot: string,\n  log: { info(m: string, ...args: unknown[]): void; warn(m: string, ...args: unknown[]): void },\n): Promise<string> {\n  const diag = (entry: Record<string, unknown>): void => {\n    appendEngageDiag(stateRoot, entry);\n  };\n  try {\n    // 空白桌面会话在首条 prompt 之前**没有活 agent**(注册表里查不到,\n    // 0.1.2 实测 engage-result: agent-session-missing)——先用 agents.resume\n    // 把活 agent 物化出来(askUser 离线投递同款冷恢复;句柄不 dispose,\n    // 锚定会话),再投递 engage 通知。\n    const id = String((agent as { id?: unknown }).id ?? '');\n    let live =\n      (ctx.agents?.get?.(id as never) as Agent | undefined) ?? undefined;\n    let resumed = false;\n    if (live === undefined) {\n      const resume = (ctx.agents as {\n        resume?: (o: {\n          resumeSessionId: SessionId;\n          signal?: AbortSignal;\n          agentOptions?: { provider?: string; model?: string; reasoningEffort?: string };\n          setup?: (agentCtx: unknown) => void | Promise<void>;\n        }) => Promise<{ agent: Agent }>;\n      }).resume;\n      if (typeof resume !== 'function') {\n        diag({ step: 'no-resume-capability', id });\n        return 'no-resume-capability';\n      }\n      const handle = await resume(\n        await resumeOptionsOf(ctx, id as unknown as SessionId, new AbortController().signal),\n      );\n      live = handle.agent;\n      resumed = true;\n    }\n    const face = live as unknown as {\n      id?: unknown;\n      session?: { events?: ReadonlyArray<{ type?: unknown }> };\n      followup?: unknown;\n      send?: unknown;\n      steer?: unknown;\n    };\n    // 空白判定与宿主 sessionBlank 同口径：无 turn/start 事件 = 会话从未开\n    // 过回合（Session.events 只读快照，同步可读）。\n    const engaged = face.session?.events?.some((event) => event.type === 'turn/start') ?? false;\n    if (engaged) {\n      diag({ step: 'engaged', id, resumed });\n      return 'engaged';\n    }\n    const primitive =\n      typeof face.followup === 'function'\n        ? 'followup'\n        : typeof face.send === 'function'\n          ? 'send'\n          : typeof face.steer === 'function'\n            ? 'steer'\n            : 'none';\n    // 零 token engage（0.1.2 agent/pre-step 契约）：在活 agent 上注册一次性\n    // pre-step 监听,engage 消息领取后被 {kind:'reject'} 拒收——回合开启并\n    // 关闭、不开步骤、**不调模型**（零 token）,turn/start 照常提交,\n    // sessionListMetadata.blank 照常清除 → 对话视图出现。一次性后放行后续\n    // step（不影响用户真实消息）。\n    const ENGAGE_MARKER = '（成员构建请求已受理';\n    const liveCtx = (live as unknown as {\n      ctx?: {\n        on?: (\n          ev: string,\n          cb: (payload: unknown, next: () => unknown) => unknown,\n        ) => (() => void) | void;\n      };\n    }).ctx;\n    let rejected = false;\n    if (typeof liveCtx?.on === 'function') {\n      liveCtx.on('agent/pre-step', (payload: unknown, next: () => unknown) => {\n        if (rejected) return next();\n        rejected = true;\n        const messages =\n          (payload as { messages?: Array<{ content?: Array<{ text?: string }> }> }).messages ?? [];\n        const texts = messages.map((m) => (m.content ?? []).map((b) => b.text ?? '').join(' '));\n        diag({ step: 'pre-step', claimed: texts.length });\n        if (!texts.some((t) => t.includes(ENGAGE_MARKER))) return next();\n        diag({ step: 'pre-step-rejected' });\n        return { kind: 'reject' };\n      });\n    }\n    // engage 通知以用户身份注入（harness 子代理初始 prompt 同款 source）：\n    // 0.1.2 桌面壳的转场看 sessionListMetadata——lastPromptAt 只认\n    // source.kind==='user' 的消息，plugin 来源的 notice 永远不清 blankBit、\n    // 对话视图不出现（2026-09-08 用户实测「卡在探索未至之境」）。内容精简:\n    // 它被 pre-step 拒收,不会真正进入对话（零 token）。\n    deliverNotice(\n      live,\n      createUserMessage({\n        content: [\n          {\n            type: 'text',\n            text: '（成员构建请求已受理——角色构建师在后台进行中，进度见构建卡片。本会话无须创建成员或调用构建工具；如无其他待办，一句话确认即可。）',\n          },\n        ],\n        source: { kind: 'user' },\n      }),\n    );\n    log.info('eteams: /eteam steered an engage notice onto a blank session');\n    // 诊断落独立日志（桌面宿主 logger 不落盘;构建 note 有子代理报告写竞态）:\n    // agent 对象的方法清单 + 所用原语,engage 投递问题的权威证据。\n    diag({\n      step: 'delivered',\n      id,\n      primitive,\n      resumed,\n      inventory: {\n        followup: typeof face.followup,\n        send: typeof face.send,\n        steer: typeof face.steer,\n        session: typeof face.session,\n      },\n    });\n    return `primitive=${primitive}${resumed ? '+resumed' : ''}`;\n  } catch (error) {\n    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n    log.warn('eteams: engage steer failed (build continues in background): %s', reason);\n    diag({ step: 'error', error: reason });\n    return 'error:' + reason;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Build the /eteam command definition. Slash input never reaches the model\n * on its own, so the handler explicitly steers the activation message onto\n * the receiving agent — an idle driver starts a turn immediately.\n */\nexport function createEteamCommand(\n  ctx: Context,\n  config: ETeamsResolvedConfig,\n  log: { info(m: string, ...args: unknown[]): void; warn(m: string, ...args: unknown[]): void },\n): CommandDefinition {\n  return {\n    name: ADD_PEOPLE_COMMAND,\n    description: '新增成员 · 角色构建师',\n    input: {\n      hint: `--add-people ${ADD_PEOPLE_BARE_BODY}`,\n      images: false,\n    },\n    handler: async ({ agent, rawInput, commandId }) => {\n      // 门禁 + 持续构建子代理受理派发（docs/19.16）：已有构建进行中则不\n      // 派发；否则 startBuilderChild（startContinuable 建立唯一构建子代理\n      // ——受理回合做查重/发布访谈/弹窗/起草，后续环节由宿主 followup\n      // 续聊同一子代理，不再起第二个）。受理即写盘（卡片首轮轮询即命中），\n      // commandId 写入会话供对话内卡片按构建归属。派发失败退回 steer 主\n      // 会话，保证流程永不哑火。\n      let root: string | null = null;\n      const diag = (step: string, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void => {\n        appendEngageDiag(root ?? rootForWrites(ctx, config), { step, ...extra });\n      };\n      diag('handler-enter');\n      try {\n        root = rootForWrites(ctx, config);\n        diag('gate-read', { root });\n        const current = readBuildSession(root);\n        if (\n          current !== null &&\n          (current.status === 'active' || current.status === 'awaiting_confirmation')\n        ) {\n          diag('gate-blocked-active-build');\n          deliverNotice(\n            agent,\n            createUserMessage({\n              content: [\n                {\n                  type: 'text',\n                  text: `已有成员构建在进行中（${current.draft?.name || '未命名'} · ${current.step}）。请到面板完成或放弃该构建后再发起新的 /eteam。`,\n                },\n              ],\n              source: {\n                kind: 'plugin',\n                plugin: 'dsh-eteams',\n                form: 'notice',\n                summary: '已有构建进行中——未派发新构建',\n              },\n            }),\n          );\n          return {\n            kind: 'success' as const,\n            text: '已有成员构建在进行中——未派发新构建，详见上方提示。',\n          };\n        }\n        if (current === null && hasBuildSessionFile(root)) {\n          // 会话文件在但读不出（瞬时 IO 竞态）——按忙处理，宁拒不漏放。\n          return {\n            kind: 'success' as const,\n            text: '构建状态正在写入，请稍候 1-2 秒重发 /eteam。',\n          };\n        }\n      } catch {\n        // 状态读不到时不拦：照常派发（受理写入 newBuild=true 会开新局）。\n      }\n      try {\n        const subagents = (ctx as unknown as RuntimeContext).subagents;\n        if (subagents?.startContinuable === undefined) {\n          throw new Error('subagents 服务不可用');\n        }\n        const stateRoot = root ?? rootForWrites(ctx, config);\n        // 立即受理（docs/19.16 用户迭代）：派发前先把受理会话写上磁盘\n        // ——卡片/新增页首轮轮询即命中、自动跳转立刻发生；request 用\n        // 用户原文，子代理从磁盘读到的就是新需求（不再继承旧会话）。\n        await reportBuildProgress(stateRoot, {\n          newBuild: true,\n          step: '收到需求',\n          stepsDone: ['收到需求'],\n          request: buildActivationMessage(rawInput),\n          note: '构建请求已受理——角色构建师启动中',\n          ...(commandId !== undefined ? { commandId } : {}),\n        });\n        diag('accepted');\n        startBuilderChild({\n          ctx: { subagents },\n          config,\n          parent: agent,\n          stateRoot,\n          logger: log,\n          onSpawnFailure: (error) => {\n            // 派发被拒 → 回滚成 cancelled，别让无子代理的 active 会话\n            // 卡住下一次 /eteam 的门禁。真实原因进 note——桌面宿主的\n            // logger.warn 不落盘，卡片是用户唯一能看到失败的表面。\n            const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n            void cancelBuildSession(\n              stateRoot,\n              `构建派发失败——请重新发起 /eteam（原因：${reason}）`,\n            ).catch(() => undefined);\n          },\n        });\n        // 空会话唤醒（docs/19.16）：受理后若会话从未开过 turn（空白会话上\n        // 斜杠命令只落 log-only 记录，主窗口仍停在未开始屏），steer 一条\n        // notice 让 idle driver 立即开 turn——对话视图出现后命令节点与构建\n        // 卡片才挂载，卡片的「发送即跳转」才接管落地。\n        diag('child-dispatched');\n        const engage = await steerEngageNotice(ctx, agent, stateRoot, log);\n        diag('engage-result', { result: engage });\n        annotateBuildSession(stateRoot, `engage=${engage}`);\n        return {\n          kind: 'success' as const,\n          text: '成员构建已受理——创建卡片与新增页已显示构建状态，意图访谈将在其上出现。',\n        };\n      } catch (error) {\n        // 受理已落盘的场合一并回滚（pre-write 成功但同步段炸了）。真实原因\n        // 进 note——桌面宿主的 logger.warn 不落盘，卡片是可见的失败表面。\n        if (root !== null) {\n          const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n          void cancelBuildSession(\n            root,\n            `构建派发失败——请重新发起 /eteam（原因：${reason}）`,\n          ).catch(() => undefined);\n        }\n        deliverNotice(\n          agent,\n          createUserMessage({\n            content: [{ type: 'text', text: buildActivationMessage(rawInput) }],\n            // Plugin-sourced notice: the conversation folds this user-role\n            // message into a compact context row (not a chat bubble) while\n            // the model still receives the full activation text (docs/19.9.5).\n            source: {\n              kind: 'plugin',\n              plugin: 'dsh-eteams',\n              form: 'notice',\n              summary: '成员创建请求已提交——构建卡片与面板实时显示进度',\n            },\n          }),\n        );\n        return { kind: 'success' as const, text: '成员创建请求已转交主会话处理。' };\n      }\n    },\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Register the /eteam command onto the commands scope（commands/index.ts 的\n * inject 回调调用；commandCtx 由 cordis inject(['commands']) 推断给出）。\n */\nexport function registerEteamCommand(\n  commandCtx: { commands: { register(c: CommandDefinition): unknown } },\n  ctx: Context,\n  config: ETeamsResolvedConfig,\n  log: { info(m: string, ...args: unknown[]): void; warn(m: string, ...args: unknown[]): void },\n): void {\n  commandCtx.commands.register(createEteamCommand(ctx, config, log));\n  log.info('eteams: /eteam command registered');\n}"

      "content": "/**\n * 死会话对账（用户 2026-09-18「应用重启后还一直是 执行中，执行中的好像没有\n * 获取状态」）：宿主重启后库里的在办 attempt 没人吊销——中断观察者靠进程内\n * 会话注册表反查、重启即空，崩溃也不会再有 turn/end 事件补记。本组锁定对账\n * 判据：只扫在办 attempt，其执行会话不在宿主活 agent 集合里即吊销并挂起；\n * 会话还活着 / 宽限期内 / 非在办一律不动。\n */\nimport { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { tmpdir } from 'node:os';\nimport { join } from 'node:path';\nimport { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis';\nimport { resolveConfig, type ETeamsResolvedConfig } from '../src/host/config';\nimport { LEADER_NAME } from '../src/host/runtime/roster';\nimport { joinPath } from '../src/host/runtime/base';\nimport {\n  installDeadSessionReconciler,\n  reconcileDeadSessions,\n  resetReconcilerForTests,\n} from '../src/host/runtime/reconcile';\nimport { readEventsSync } from '../src/host/state/events';\nimport { insertTeamRow, readTeamSync, withTeamTx, writeTeamInTx } from '../src/host/state/store';\nimport type { AttemptRecord, TaskMemberRecord, TeamState } from '../src/host/model/types';\nimport { cleanupTempWorkspace } from './support/tmpWorkspace';\n\nlet ws: string;\nlet root: string;\nlet config: ETeamsResolvedConfig;\n\n/** 在办尝试所用的成员子会话 id（测试用固定值，模拟重启前派发出去的会话）。 */\nconst MEMBER_SESSION = 'sess-member-1';\nconst SUB_TASK_ID = 2;\nconst GROUP_TASK_ID = 1;\n\n/**\n * 播种：容器（start）+ 小任务（start，带一个 running attempt）+\n * 成员副本行（绑会话）。attempt 的既有形状照 attempts 表（v7 task_member_id）。\n */\nfunction seedTeam(opts: { memberSessionId?: string; attemptStatus?: AttemptRecord['status'] } = {}): number {\n  let teamId = 0;\n  withTeamTx(root, undefined, (tx) => {\n    teamId = insertTeamRow(tx, '演示团队', true, tx.now);\n  });\n  const attempt: AttemptRecord = {\n    id: 1,\n    taskId: SUB_TASK_ID,\n    kind: 'initial',\n    member: 'Alice',\n    taskMemberId: 5,\n    status: opts.attemptStatus ?? 'running',\n    token: 'tok',\n    stationIndex: -1,\n    createdAt: 1,\n    claimedAt: 1,\n    progress: [],\n  };\n  const leaderRow: TaskMemberRecord = {\n    id: 4,\n    teamId,\n    mainTaskId: GROUP_TASK_ID,\n    nowTaskId: null,\n    name: LEADER_NAME,\n    employeeId: null,\n    sessionId: '',\n    roleId: null,\n    status: 'ready',\n    isLeader: true,\n    createdAt: 1,\n  };\n  const memberRow: TaskMemberRecord = {\n    id: 5,\n    teamId,\n    mainTaskId: GROUP_TASK_ID,\n    nowTaskId: SUB_TASK_ID,\n    name: 'Alice',\n    employeeId: 2,\n    sessionId: opts.memberSessionId ?? MEMBER_SESSION,\n    roleId: null,\n    status: 'ready',\n    createdAt: 1,\n  };\n  const team: TeamState = {\n    id: teamId,\n    name: '演示团队',\n    hasLeader: true,\n    createdAt: 1,\n    updatedAt: 1,\n    members: [\n      {\n        memberId: 2,\n        roleId: null,\n        name: 'Alice',\n        employeeId: 2,\n        role: 'engineer',\n        persona: {\n          frameworkVersion: 1,\n          role: 'engineer',\n          duty: '',\n          style: '',\n          skills: '',\n          rules: [],\n          executionPrompt: '',\n        },\n        modelRoute: { model: '' },\n        avatar: { seed: 1, salt: 1 },\n        createdAt: 1,\n      },\n    ],\n    taskMembers: [leaderRow, memberRow],\n    tasks: [\n      {\n        id: GROUP_TASK_ID,\n        subject: '容器',\n        parentId: null,\n        dependencies: [],\n        chain: [],\n        chainCursor: -1,\n        status: 'start',\n        attempts: [],\n        retryCount: 0,\n        mainSessionId: 'cap-1',\n        createdAt: 1,\n        updatedAt: 1,\n      },\n      {\n        id: SUB_TASK_ID,\n        subject: '小任务',\n        parentId: GROUP_TASK_ID,\n        dependencies: [],\n        chain: [],\n        chainCursor: -1,\n        status: 'start',\n        attempts: [attempt],\n        retryCount: 0,\n        createdAt: 1,\n        updatedAt: 1,\n      },\n    ],\n    pendingDecisions: [],\n  };\n  withTeamTx(root, teamId, (tx) => writeTeamInTx(tx, team));\n  return teamId;\n}\n\n/** 最小宿主 ctx：活 agent 列表（存活判据）+ 工作区注册表（状态根枚举）。 */\nfunction fakeCtx(liveIds: readonly string[]): Context {\n  return {\n    logger: { info: () => undefined, warn: () => undefined },\n    get: (key: string) =>\n      key === 'workspaceRegistry' || key === 'workspace'\n        ? { list: () => [{ path: ws, title: 'ws' }] }\n        : undefined,\n    agents: { list: () => liveIds.map((id) => ({ id })) },\n  } as unknown as Context;\n}\n\nbeforeEach(() => {\n  ws = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'eteams-reconcile-'));\n  root = joinPath(ws, '.eteams');\n  config = resolveConfig({ stateDir: '.eteams' });\n});\n\nafterEach(() => {\n  resetReconcilerForTests();\n  cleanupTempWorkspace(ws);\n});\n\ndescribe('死会话对账（宿主重启后的在办 attempt）', () => {\n  it('活集合为空（重启）→ 吊销 attempt、小任务挂起、容器同步挂起、留痕 session.dead', async () => {\n    const teamId = seedTeam();\n    const paused = await reconcileDeadSessions(fakeCtx([]), config, { graceMs: 0 });\n    expect(paused).toBe(1);\n\n    const team = readTeamSync(root, teamId)!;\n    const sub = team.tasks.find((t) => t.id === SUB_TASK_ID)!;\n    expect(sub.status).toBe('paused');\n    expect(sub.attempts[0]!.status).toBe('revoked');\n    // 容器由「有在办小任务」派生：小任务挂起后主任务同步挂起（用户迭代 2026-09-11）。\n    expect(team.tasks.find((t) => t.id === GROUP_TASK_ID)!.status).toBe('paused');\n\n    const suspended = readEventsSync(root, teamId).find((e) => e.type === 'task.suspended');\n    expect(suspended).toBeDefined();\n    expect((suspended!.payload as Record<string, unknown>).via).toBe('session.dead');\n  });\n\n  it('会话仍在活集合里 → 不判死、状态不动', async () => {\n    const teamId = seedTeam();\n    const paused = await reconcileDeadSessions(fakeCtx([MEMBER_SESSION]), config, { graceMs: 0 });\n    expect(paused).toBe(0);\n    const team = readTeamSync(root, teamId)!;\n    expect(team.tasks.find((t) => t.id === SUB_TASK_ID)!.status).toBe('start');\n    expect(team.tasks.find((t) => t.id === SUB_TASK_ID)!.attempts[0]!.status).toBe('running');\n  });\n\n  it('宽限期内（在办时长 < graceMs）→ 即使不在活集合里也不动', async () => {\n    const teamId = seedTeam();\n    // since = 1（远古），用「现在就是 since」模拟刚派出：now - since = 0 < grace。\n    const paused = await reconcileDeadSessions(fakeCtx([]), config, { graceMs: 1_000, now: 1 });\n    expect(paused).toBe(0);\n    expect(readTeamSync(root, teamId)!.tasks.find((t) => t.id === SUB_TASK_ID)!.status).toBe('start');\n  });\n\n  it('成员会话从未建立（sessionId 为空）→ 过宽限期同样挂起', async () => {\n    const teamId = seedTeam({ memberSessionId: '' });\n    const paused = await reconcileDeadSessions(fakeCtx([]), config, { graceMs: 0 });\n    expect(paused).toBe(1);\n    expect(readTeamSync(root, teamId)!.tasks.find((t) => t.id === SUB_TASK_ID)!.status).toBe('paused');\n  });\n\n  it('非在办 attempt（已 succeeded）→ 不在扫描范围，不动', async () => {\n    const teamId = seedTeam({ attemptStatus: 'succeeded' });\n    const paused = await reconcileDeadSessions(fakeCtx([]), config, { graceMs: 0 });\n    expect(paused).toBe(0);\n    expect(readTeamSync(root, teamId)!.tasks.find((t) => t.id === SUB_TASK_ID)!.status).toBe('start');\n  });\n\n  it('活 agent 服务缺失（旧运行时）→ 当空集合处理，不抛异常', async () => {\n    const teamId = seedTeam();\n    const ctx = {\n      logger: { info: () => undefined, warn: () => undefined },\n      get: (key: string) =>\n        key === 'workspaceRegistry' ? { list: () => [{ path: ws, title: 'ws' }] } : undefined,\n    } as unknown as Context;\n    const paused = await reconcileDeadSessions(ctx, config, { graceMs: 0 });\n    expect(paused).toBe(1);\n    expect(readTeamSync(root, teamId)!.tasks.find((t) => t.id === SUB_TASK_ID)!.status).toBe('paused');\n  });\n\n  it('install 只排启动快扫、不设常驻周期（用户 2026-09-18「去掉轮询」）', () => {\n    const intervalSpy = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'setInterval');\n    const timeoutSpy = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'setTimeout');\n    installDeadSessionReconciler(fakeCtx([]), config);\n    // 启动快扫确实排了 timer（证明 spy 生效）……\n    expect(timeoutSpy).toHaveBeenCalled();\n    // ……但没有任何常驻周期扫描。\n    expect(intervalSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    intervalSpy.mockRestore();\n    timeoutSpy.mockRestore();\n  });\n});\n"
    }
  ],
